summary: 유럽과 아시아에서 번식하고, 겨울에는 온대에서 아열대 지역까지 내려가 지내는 갈매기다. 여름깃은 머리가 밤색이고, 겨울깃은 머리가 희어지며 귀깃 자리에 검은 점이 남는다.

art.subject: Black-headed Gull (Chroicocephalus ridibundus), adult in winter plumage, as seen on Korean estuaries and harbours from November to March: white head with a dark ear-spot behind the eye and faint grey smudges above the eye and over the crown; back and upperwings pale grey; outer primaries white along the leading edge with black tips; underparts and tail white. Bill slender, red with a dark tip. Dark eye. Red legs.
art.scene: Korean estuary in winter, tidal mudflat and a calm channel at the river mouth with a resting flock of small gulls, soft low winter light; no people, buildings or text
views: adult breeding (from late March before departure), side view standing: dark chocolate-brown hood over the face, crown and throat with a white nape, broken white crescent behind the eye, pale grey upperwing, dark red bill and legs
adult winter, head detail in profile: white head with a dark ear-spot behind the eye and faint grey smudges above the eye, red bill with a dark tip
first-winter, side view standing: brown carpal bar and dark brown tertials on pale grey wings, dark ear-spot, orange-red bill with dark tip, dull orange legs, black tail band
adult in flight seen from above, body level: pale grey upperwing with a white wedge along the leading edge of the outer wing and black tips to the primaries
art.build: Small, slim gull, about 40cm, clearly smaller and slighter than Common Gull and far smaller than Vega Gull; rounded head, slender neck. Bill thin, straight, fairly long for a small gull. Legs medium length, red. At rest the black-tipped primaries project well beyond the tail. In flight narrow pointed wings with a long white wedge along the leading edge of the outer wing, black tips to the primaries and dusky grey underside to the inner primaries. Tail white, square. Buoyant, agile flight.
avoid: Do not paint a jet-black hood — the breeding hood is dark chocolate-brown and does not reach the nape.
Do not paint a short, stubby black bill — that is the smaller Saunders's Gull (Chroicocephalus saundersi).
Do not show the brown hood on birds in a winter scene; winter adults are white-headed with an ear-spot.
Do not paint yellow legs or bill, or black wingtips with large white mirrors (larger gulls).
